name: LedgerNest
one_liner: Automated recurring billing, usage metering, and revenue reporting for SaaS finance teams.

hard_problems.title: Out-of-order Stripe webhook state reconciliation
hard_problems.description: Payment gateway webhook deliveries arrive out of sequence and duplicate retries race against checkout callbacks, risking double-invoicing or stale subscription entitlements.

hard_problems.title: Multi-currency mid-cycle proration without rounding drift
hard_problems.description: Upgrades across tiered seat plans and zero-decimal currencies accumulate sub-cent invoice discrepancies against append-only double-entry accounting exports.

hard_problems.title: Sub-300ms MRR cohort queries over 2M+ invoice lines
hard_problems.description: Tenant finance dashboards run arbitrary slice-and-dice retention queries that trigger sequential scans and lock contention during end-of-month close.
